name: CinnaWM - Hybrid Tiling & Window Manager
description: Advanced hybrid tiling and window manager for Cinnamon (inspired by Hyprland, i3/Sway, dwm, Pop!_OS Shell, Niri, and gTile): Dwindle/BSP, Master-Stack, Centered Master, Scrolling Columns, Monocle, Scratchpad, Mouse Drag-to-Swap, Live Edge Resize, and Quick Snap Grid.
